jobDescription: The motor insurance pricing team sets the rates behind the insurer's motor quotes. The Pricing Analyst refreshes the rating factors from the claims and quote data, prepares the rate change proposals with their impact analysis, runs the pricing model monitoring, prepares the monthly pricing pack for the pricing committee, and documents each proposal's limitations. Rate changes are approved by the pricing committee. Reports to the head of motor pricing; works with the actuarial team, the underwriting team and the data platform team.
requirements: Refreshes rating factors from claims and quote data under the pricing team's refresh procedure.
Prepares rate change proposals with impact analysis, with approval staying with the pricing committee.
Runs the pricing model monitoring and raises drift to the actuarial team.
Prepares the monthly pricing pack for the pricing committee and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents each proposal's limitations and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Pricing analyst in the motor pricing team of a personal lines insurer for three years, refreshing the rating factors from the claims and quote data each quarter under the team's refresh procedure.
Prepared eleven rate change proposals with their impact analysis; each was approved or amended by the pricing committee, with the committee's decision recorded on the proposal.
Ran the pricing model monitoring each month and raised three drift cases to the actuarial team, recorded in the monitoring log.
Prepared the monthly pricing pack for the pricing committee, recording in the pack which analyses were mine and which came from the actuarial team.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each rate change proposal.

Work sample: one rate change proposal with its impact analysis and the committee decision record, one monthly pricing pack and the monitoring log extract for the three drift cases, with the pricing repository references as a verification trail.

Reference call with the former head of motor pricing: confirmed the candidate prepared the proposals and the packs in the period, with the rate decisions taken by the committee, and confirmed the employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate is available for the technical exercise on either of the two proposed dates and has no relocation or travel constraints for the role.
